title: Mohammad: keep the cut or choose an optional draw change

people.student: Mohammad in source title overlay; ASR spells Mohamed

coverage.transcript_kind: Local MLX Whisper ASR with visual inspection
coverage.visual_review_method: 10 overview and 28 detail frames across four portrait sheets inspected; takeaway, top match, conditional annotations and original shot reviewed.
limitations: Coach reasoning is attributed, not independently validated.

evidence.session: Mohammad: keep the cut or choose an optional draw change
evidence.summary: Coach calls swing simple and efficient and reports plus handicap. Praises takeaway on plane, face matching spine, halfway-back shaft toward ball and hip turn inferred from visible space between knees. These are qualitative judgments.
limitations: 2D annotated footage; no independent causal validation.

evidence.session: Mohammad: keep the cut or choose an optional draw change
evidence.summary: Top has hands over middle of feet and lead arm above shoulder plane, but lead-wrist flexion makes face stronger than arm. Coach calls this a useful match, citing tour players as examples of possible cut-oriented patterns rather than demonstrating them.
limitations: 2D annotated footage; no independent causal validation.

evidence.session: Mohammad: keep the cut or choose an optional draw change
evidence.summary: Explicit branch: keep exact position for a cut preference; only if golfer wants stock draws, work on lead-arm depth and hands more over heels. Drawn target lines illustrate optional change, not achieved new position.

frames.observation: Original top retained for cut branch.

limitations: 2D annotated footage; no independent causal validation.

evidence.session: Mohammad: keep the cut or choose an optional draw change
evidence.summary: Coach praises original shallowing, straight initial direction, hands exiting left with face control and starting toward middle green despite right pin. Original shot shown, but no measured trajectory, landing or dispersion. Plus-one handicap is stated by coach.

frames.observation: Arrow points toward right flag area.

limitations: 2D annotated footage; no independent causal validation.

cases.title: Keep high hands and stronger face when the cut pattern works
cases.coaching_finding: Coach sees high hands and lead arm above shoulders with flexed lead wrist and stronger face, plus effective original delivery.
cases.coach_reasoning: He treats positions as compatible with good golf and explicitly permits them for a cut-oriented player.

intervention.action: Retain current top position if the golfer wants the cut pattern and outcomes support it.

applicability: Golfer prefers cut and demonstrates useful delivery and results.
Do not infer shot shape from wrist pose alone.
unknowns: Actual measured face/path and distribution of shots.
cases.observed_result: Original shot and coach approval; no correction trial.

selection.policy_origin: User one-focus preference; retain source sequencing and avoid simultaneous competing thoughts.
selection.reassess: Proposed app check: ask shot preference and review real outcomes before proposing cosmetic top changes.

cases.title: Consider more depth only for an explicit draw goal
cases.coaching_finding: Same accepted high top becomes optional change candidate only under a different shot goal.
cases.coach_reasoning: Coach proposes deeper lead arm and hands nearer heels to pursue a stock draw.

intervention.action: Work on lead-arm depth and hands more over heels.
intervention.limits: No drill, dose, grip change or exact position tolerance supplied.

applicability: User explicitly wants to change preferred shape to draw.
Recheck face and delivery after change; depth alone does not guarantee draw.
unknowns: Specific teaching procedure and actual response.
cases.observed_result: Hypothetical option only; no draw attempt shown.

selection.coaching_focus: Optional backswing depth for chosen shape
selection.policy_origin: User one-focus preference; retain source sequencing and avoid simultaneous competing thoughts.
selection.reassess: Proposed app check: test actual start line and curvature with same club, while retaining the original cut as a valid option.

limits: Not independently verified and not calculated from swing appearance.

measurement_register.value: Face relative to spine/lead arm, hand depth, knee gap and target direction
limits: No calibrated 3D angles, force or shot-tracking measurements. Knee gap alone is not quantified hip rotation.

source_ambiguities.issue: ASR shadow/scarf ball are wording errors in context of shallowing and golf ball; original ASR retained. No numerical claim depends on correction.
Closing repeated Bye ASR ignored as noncoaching.

cross_source_links.relation: High top is not sufficient diagnosis
cross_source_links.explanation: Ryan's high top is selected for change in a steep slice sequence. Mohammad's high top is accepted with stronger face and effective preferred cut. Face, delivery and goal are required to distinguish cases.
Both reviews preserve a nonstandard appearance because the coach judges its accompanying conditions functional.

within_source_distinctions.relationship: Mutually exclusive goal branches: retain preferred cut versus consider a deliberate draw change.

annotation_opportunities: Show observed top separately from optional desired-depth lines.
Place player shot intention beside recommendation.
Distinguish right-pin annotation from measured landing.
excluded_material: Named tour-player comparison treated as dataset evidence.

independent_validation.reason: Source extraction preserves evidence and conditions; a source match and response check are still needed for another golfer.
